title: Pavement Condition Assessment
short_description: Consulting services for countywide pavement assessment and a five-year pavement management plan.
project_scope: Professional services to perform a pavement condition assessment for approximately 692 miles of road in San Joaquin County and optionally prepare a five-year pavement management plan.
services: Pavement condition assessment and optional pavement management planning; requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, inspection services, materials testing, planning/master planning, public transit planning, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a road pavement assessment and management planning assignment, not a bridge or structural design project.
- The scope focuses on condition surveys, planning, GIS/mapping, testing, and transportation planning.
- It does not involve long-span structures, special structures, buildings, roofs, or architecturally demanding engineering.
- The tender aligns with excluded or low-priority areas such as pure planning/assessment rather than structural engineering design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The assignment is for assessment and planning services for approximately 692 miles of roadway; no realistic construction cost can be derived from the provided information alone.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget information is stated in the source documents.
references_qualifications: Proposers must have sufficient expertise and experience to complete the pavement condition assessment and optional pavement management plan. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
